rules.title: Berkeley owner move-in and Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance (2026 amounts)
rules.requirement: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance when evicting for an owner move-in or to withdraw the unit from the rental market (Ellis). From January 1, 2026 the standard payment is $19,413, with an additional $6,471 for qualifying households. Amounts are adjusted yearly with CPI.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.effective_date_note: Date the 2026 inflation-adjusted amounts took effect, approved by the Rent Board on October 16, 2025. The underlying relocation requirement predates this.

unverifiable_exemptions: Exemptions under the Rent Ordinance are not stated in this document

parsed.doc_summary: Berkeley Rent Board news item announcing 2026 inflation adjustments to owner move-in and Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance payments ($19,413 standard; $6,471 additional), effective January 1, 2026.
